expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final command given is "source ~/venvs/cv-tf/bin/activate" (or "~/venvs/cv-tf/bin/python") with no expected output/behaviour stated; the verification ("TF matmul OK") was run by the agent, not offered as a learner checkpoint.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Ran install commands ("pip install --upgrade pip", "pip install opencv-python tensorflow") and wrote outside the project dir ("python3.11 -m venv ~/venvs/cv-tf", venv at ~/venvs/cv-tf).
